descriptions.notStarted: I found a letter in the trash, all crumpled up in a ball. It looked like someone was in the middle of writing the letter when they decided to throw it away...It's hard to read what's written there because of all the creases everywhere, but I think I see the name ''Athena Pierce'' faintly across the page. I wonder if I can find the person to whom this letter belongs?
descriptions.inProgress: While I was trying to read the letter, Muirhat approached me with a suspicious look and started asking why I am reading Kyrin's letter. I told him that I had found it in the trash, and to that, he asked if I would be interested in delivering Kyrin's letter to #bAthena Pierce#k in #bHenesys#k.
descriptions.completed: I've delivered the letter to Athena Pierce as Muirhat had asked me to.
